create.name: Insight Meditation Center
create.bio:
Insight Meditation Center, usually called IMC, is a non-residential Buddhist meditation centre in Redwood City, California, teaching insight (vipassana) practice in the Theravada-rooted Western tradition. It grew out of a small Palo Alto sitting group formed in 1986; Gil Fronsdal became its regular teacher in 1990, and he and Andrea Fella now serve as its guiding teachers, supported by a wide circle of trained dharma teachers and lay leaders. The community bought a former church on Birch Street in 2001 and opened it as a meditation hall the following year.

Everything IMC offers is given freely and supported by donations and volunteers. Its week includes early-morning guided sits streamed on YouTube, evening sittings with talks, loving-kindness sessions on Zoom, beginners' instruction, yoga and a range of affinity and study groups, along with daylong retreats and year-long programmes such as the Eightfold Path course. Silent residential retreats run at its sister centre, the Insight Retreat Center near Santa Cruz, and decades of recorded talks are shared through AudioDharma, so people far from the Bay Area can follow the teaching online.

courses.title: Saturday Nov 21: Mindfulness Practice with Knowing, Allowing, Sensing, and Calming Daylong
courses.description: A day of silent practice at the Redwood City hall led by Tanya Wiser and Shelley Gault. Guided instructions on breath, body, emotions and thoughts alternate with sitting, walking, talks and small-group discussion; newcomers and experienced meditators are both welcome.

courses.title: Saturday Dec 12: Embodied Presence Daylong with Kim Allen
courses.description: An in-person day at IMC with Kim Allen exploring the body as a doorway into Buddhist practice. The day mixes guided and silent sitting, walking meditation and dharma teaching, with optional meetings with the teacher.

courses.title: December 27-31: Non-residential Online Daily Life Retreat with Andrea Fella
courses.description: A five-day home retreat on Zoom with guiding teacher Andrea Fella, drawing on the approach of Sayadaw U Tejaniya. Each morning brings instruction, guided practice and discussion, with an optional afternoon question session, and the focus is on carrying relaxed awareness through ordinary activities.

courses.title: Residential Retreats at the Insight Retreat Center
courses.description: IMC's sister retreat house just outside Santa Cruz holds silent insight meditation retreats through the year, run by volunteers. Places are offered without a fee and the retreats are sustained by participants' donations.

free_resources.title: Beginning Meditation Instruction
free_resources.description: IMC's starting points for newcomers: a weekly drop-in instruction class at the centre, weekday loving-kindness sessions on Zoom and a self-paced five-week introduction built from Gil Fronsdal's recorded course and handouts.

free_resources.title: Introduction to Mindfulness Meditation
free_resources.description: A written course in five steps, moving from mindfulness of breathing to the body, emotions, thinking and daily life. Each section explains the practice and gives simple instructions to try.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: A browsable gallery of recorded guided sittings by IMC teachers, drawn from the centre's video archive for anyone practising at home.

free_resources.title: 7am Guided Sit & Talk
free_resources.description: An archive of the weekday morning livestreams, each pairing half an hour of lightly guided sitting with a short reflection on that week's theme. Hundreds of past sessions can be browsed and replayed.
